programme.title: 07 21 The Tenpenny Files - The Book of Heaven - Katie Asher
programme.desc: What her son revealed about autism full consciousness and being trapped inside a body that wouldn’t respond He was fully aware the whole time able to hear everything understand everything and feel everything yet he had no way to respond after the shots they were told would protect him Parents have been saying this for years A child develops normally something changes and nothing returns to what it was They try to explain what they saw and are dismissed while their child slips behind a diagnosis that does not match what they experienced Katie Asher is talking about her son Houston and this episode shows what non-speaking autism can look like when awareness is still fully there She watched him lose abilities in real time and saw a clear gap between what she was being told and what was actually happening This is about severe autism where communication is gone but awareness may remain and it brings forward a reality many people have not considered A child can hear you understand you and feel everything around them while having no consistent way to respond That condition reshapes the entire family and changes daily life in ways most people never see Siblings grow up under pressure that is rarely acknowledged and the outside world often assumes something very different from what is happening inside the home Everything changes when communication opens After seventeen years Houston speaks and later he begins communicating through spelling What comes through is direct and consistent He was aware the entire time That does not fit the way most people understand intelligence or the brain Houston then describes awareness that does not depend on his body and expresses understanding that was never directly taught He communicates perception that does not rely on speech or typical interaction Katie Asher explains how this experience changed how she understands consciousness suffering and faith and how it forced her to confront the possibility that awareness is not limited to the body in the way she once believed If this is real it changes how you see every non-speaking child you have ever met

programme.title: The Tenpenny Files - When Persecution Comes - Charles Crismier
programme.desc: Christian persecution is no longer a distant headline Charles Crismier explains why it is already advancing in the West and why most believers still fail to recognize it This conversation makes clear what that pressure looks like in daily life and why spiritual readiness cannot be delayed Dr Tenpenny brings the discussion into real decisions people are making right now Charles Crismier describes legal pressure cultural coercion and reputational loss that force quiet compromise long before open hostility appears He explains why many Christians still believe America is exempt and why that assumption is leaving families exposed The focus turns to preparation and where it must begin Charles Crismier says churches have not prepared their people for what is coming He says parents have not trained children to stand when conviction carries a cost He says fathers must reclaim spiritual leadership inside the home He rejects the idea that preparation is material He points to the heart as the place where strength is formed before pressure arrives The conversation also moves into biblical timing and why he believes the window for preparation is narrowing He explains how compromise happens in stages and why a divided heart fails when pressure becomes personal You hear the urgency behind his warning and the specific areas where he believes the church is weakest This interview brings clarity to what is already unfolding and forces the listener to examine their own readiness His book When Persecution Comes Preparing Hearts for Perilous Times goes further into the structure the scripture and the questions that cannot be covered in one conversation The interview shows where the pressure is building The book shows what must be built before it arrives
